result.description: LumaDock Aurora 4TB NVMe Portable Archive is a compact external solid-state storage device designed for fast media backup, project transfer, and field archiving. It uses USB 3.2 Gen 2 connectivity, supports sustained high-speed sequential reads and writes, and includes an aluminum enclosure for improved thermal handling. Intended for creators and mobile professionals rather than gaming or workstation graphics use.
result.title: LumaDock Aurora 4TB NVMe Portable Archive
